_comment: The Pressbooks networks this tool offers. There is no directory API that enumerates them, so this list ships with the binary.

Every entry was probed on 2026-09-04 with the User-Agent this tool sends. That matters: these hosts answer an unrecognised client with 403, so a probe with a bare tool name reports far more of them unreachable than really are.

Probe with a Go net/http client, not curl. Cloudflare's bot detection keys on the TLS and HTTP fingerprint as well as the User-Agent, and curl and Go present different fingerprints for the same headers. A curl-based probe wrongly reported pressbooks.bccampus.ca and opentextbc.ca as blocked; a Go client reaches both fine, and they were moved here from `excluded` on 2026-09-04 once that was found.
`books` is what was observed at that probe and conveys scale only. The live count comes from the X-WP-Total header at crawl time.

`excluded` exists so a host nobody can reach is not re-added later by someone who rediscovers the problem by hand. Do not move an entry out of it without re-probing with a Go client and recording what changed.

This is the Pressbooks Directory host; its api.pressbooks.com backend is an undocumented JavaScript application, not a public API.
